verdict.rationale: Choosing a storage region is a fair question for a SaaS finance platform like Ramp, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any data-residency or region-selection option. The 'Banking is US-only' note describes product availability, not a customer choice of where data is stored, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
